sanskrit: kuśais tu bhūmau śayanaṃ cakāra; mādrīsutaḥ sahadevas tarasvī yathātmīyāny ajināni sarve; saṃstīrya vīrāḥ suṣupur dharaṇyām
english: Sahadeva, the swift son of Mādrī, made his bed upon the ground with kusha grass; and all the heroes, spreading their own antelope hides, slept upon the earth.

sanskrit: agastyaśāstām abhito diśaṃ tu; śirāṃsi teṣāṃ kurusattamānām kuntī purastāt tu babhūva teṣāṃ; kṛṣṇā tiraś caiva babhūva pattaḥ
english: Their heads, those best of the Kurus, faced the direction governed by Agastya; Kuntī lay before them and Kṛṣṇa lay crosswise at their feet.

sanskrit: aśeta bhūmau saha pāṇḍuputraiḥ; pādopadhāneva kṛtā kuśeṣu na tatra duḥkhaṃ ca babhūva tasyā; na cāvamene kurupuṃgavāṃs tān
english: She lay upon the ground alongside the sons of Pāṇḍu, made as if a footrest on the kusha; yet she felt no sorrow there, nor did those bulls among the Kurus disrespect her.

sanskrit: te tatra śūrāḥ kathayāṃ babhūvuḥ; kathā vicitrāḥ pṛtanādhikārāḥ astrāṇi divyāni rathāṃś ca nāgān; khaḍgān gadāś cāpi paraśvadhāṃś ca
english: Those heroes there began to converse, telling varied tales befitting warriors in command of armies — divine weapons, chariots and war-elephants, swords, maces, and battle-axes.

sanskrit: teṣāṃ kathās tāḥ parikīrtyamānāḥ; pāñcālarājasya sutas tadānīm śuśrāva kṛṣṇāṃ ca tathā niṣaṇṇāṃ; te cāpi sarve dadṛśur manuṣyāḥ
english: As those tales were being recounted, the son of the Pāñcāla king heard them, and also saw Kṛṣṇa seated there; and all the people saw them too.

sanskrit: dhṛṣṭadyumno rājaputras tu sarvaṃ; vṛttaṃ teṣāṃ kathitaṃ caiva rātrau sarvaṃ rājñe drupadāyākhilena; nivedayiṣyaṃs tvarito jagāma
english: Prince Dhṛṣṭadyumna, having heard everything that had transpired and all that was said that night, went in haste to report it all in full to King Drupada.

sanskrit: pāñcālarājas tu viṣaṇṇarūpas; tān pāṇḍavān aprativindamānaḥ dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ paryapṛcchan mahātmā; kva sā gatā kena nītā ca kṛṣṇā
english: The king of Pāñcāla, his face cast down and unable to identify those Pāṇḍavas, questioned Dhṛṣṭadyumna, that great-souled one: "Where has Kṛṣṇa gone, and by whom was she taken?"

sanskrit: kaccin na śūdreṇa na hīnajena; vaiśyena vā karadenopapannā kaccit padaṃ mūrdhni na me nidigdhaṃ; kaccin mālā patitā na śmaśāne
english: "Has she not been taken by a Śūdra, or a man of low birth, or a Vaiśya tributary? Has my head not been pressed underfoot? Has the garland not fallen in the cremation ground?"

sanskrit: kaccit savarṇapravaro manuṣya; udriktavarṇo 'py uta veha kaccit kaccin na vāmo mama mūrdhni pādaḥ; kṛṣṇābhimarśena kṛto 'dya putra
english: "Is the man foremost of his own caste, or perhaps of a higher varna? Or has a left foot today been placed upon my head, my son, by the one who has touched Kṛṣṇa?"

sanskrit: kaccic ca yakṣye paramapratītaḥ; saṃyujya pārthena nararṣabheṇa bravīhi tattvena mahānubhāvaḥ; ko 'sau vijetā duhitur mamādya
english: "Shall I worship with supreme confidence, having secured the bull among men, the Pārtha? Tell me truly, O great-spirited one — who is he who has won my daughter today?"

sanskrit: vicitravīryasya tu kaccid adya; kurupravīrasya dharanti putrāḥ kaccit tu pārthena yavīyasādya; dhanur gṛhītaṃ nihataṃ ca lakṣyam
english: "Do the sons of Vicitravīrya, those heroes among the Kurus, yet survive? And was the bow taken up and the target struck down today by the younger Pārtha?"

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca tatas tathoktaḥ parihṛṣṭarūpaḥ; pitre śaśaṃsātha sa rājaputraḥ dhṛṣṭadyumnaḥ somakānāṃ prabarho; vṛttaṃ yathā yena hṛtā ca kṛṣṇā
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Thus questioned, his face filled with joy, the prince Dhṛṣṭadyumna, foremost of the Somakas, reported to his father what had happened and by whom Kṛṣṇa had been taken.

sanskrit: yo 'sau yuvā svāyatalohitākṣaḥ; kṛṣṇājinī devasamānarūpaḥ yaḥ kārmukāgryaṃ kṛtavān adhijyaṃ; lakṣyaṃ ca tat pātitavān pṛthivyām
english: "That young man with large reddish eyes, wearing a black antelope skin, equal in beauty to a god — it was he who strung the foremost bow and brought the target crashing to the earth."

sanskrit: asajjamānaś ca gatas tarasvī; vṛto dvijāgryair abhipūjyamānaḥ cakrāma vajrīva diteḥ suteṣu; sarvaiś ca devair ṛṣibhiś ca juṣṭaḥ
english: "Unimpeded, he went swiftly, surrounded and honored by the foremost twice-born, moving among the sons of Diti like Indra with his thunderbolt, honored by all the gods and sages."

sanskrit: kṛṣṇā ca gṛhyājinam anvayāt taṃ; nāgaṃ yathā nāgavadhūḥ prahṛṣṭā amṛṣyamāṇeṣu narādhipeṣu; kruddheṣu taṃ tatra samāpatatsu
english: "And Kṛṣṇa, taking hold of the antelope hide, followed him with joy, as an elephant cow follows her mate, even as the kings of men, refusing to accept it, charged furiously at him there."

sanskrit: tato 'paraḥ pārthivarājamadhye; pravṛddham ārujya mahīpraroham prakālayann eva sa pārthivaughān; kruddho 'ntakaḥ prāṇabhṛto yathaiva
english: "Then another, uprooting a great tree from the earth in the midst of those royal lords, drove back the flood of kings like Death himself, enraged, driving back the living."

sanskrit: tau pārthivānāṃ miṣatāṃ narendra; kṛṣṇām upādāya gatau narāgryau vibhrājamānāv iva candrasūryau; bāhyāṃ purād bhārgavakarmaśālām
english: "Those two foremost of men, O lord of kings, took Kṛṣṇa away before the very eyes of all the kings, shining like the sun and moon, to the workshop of Bharadvaja's son outside the city."

sanskrit: tatropaviṣṭārcir ivānalasya; teṣāṃ janitrīti mama pratarkaḥ tathāvidhair eva narapravīrais; upopaviṣṭais tribhir agnikalpaiḥ
english: "Seated there, blazing like a flame of fire, is, I conjecture, their mother; and seated near her are three other foremost of men, equal in splendor to fire."

sanskrit: tasyās tatas tāv abhivādya pādāv; uktvā ca kṛṣṇām abhivādayeti sthitau ca tatraiva nivedya kṛṣṇāṃ; bhaikṣapracārāya gatā narāgryāḥ
english: "Those two then bowed at her feet, said to Kṛṣṇa 'pay your respects,' and having presented Kṛṣṇa there, those foremost of men went out to beg alms."

sanskrit: teṣāṃ tu bhaikṣaṃ pratigṛhya kṛṣṇā; kṛtvā baliṃ brāhmaṇasāc ca kṛtvā tāṃ caiva vṛddhāṃ pariviṣya tāṃś ca; narapravīrān svayam apy abhuṅkta
english: "Kṛṣṇa received their alms, made the customary offering, gave a portion to the brahmins, served that elder woman and those foremost of men, and herself ate as well."

sanskrit: suptās tu te pārthiva sarva eva; kṛṣṇā tu teṣāṃ caraṇopadhānam āsīt pṛthivyāṃ śayanaṃ ca teṣāṃ; darbhājināgryāstaraṇopapannam
english: "All of them, O king, then slept, while Kṛṣṇa became a footrest at their feet; their bed was upon the earth, furnished with a spread of the finest darbha grass and antelope hides."

sanskrit: te nardamānā iva kālameghāḥ; kathā vicitrāḥ kathayāṃ babhūvuḥ na vaiśyaśūdraupayikīḥ kathās tā; na ca dvijāteḥ kathayanti vīrāḥ
english: "They roared like dark monsoon clouds as they told their varied tales; those heroes spoke no tales fit for a Vaiśya or a Śūdra, nor indeed of twice-born men."

sanskrit: niḥsaṃśayaṃ kṣatriyapuṃgavās te; yathā hi yuddhaṃ kathayanti rājan āśā hi no vyaktam iyaṃ samṛddhā; muktān hi pārthāñ śṛṇumo 'gnidāhāt
english: "They are without doubt bulls among Kṣatriyas, O king, for they speak of battle as warriors do; indeed our hope is now clearly fulfilled, for we hear the Pārthas have escaped the fire."

sanskrit: yathā hi lakṣyaṃ nihataṃ dhanuś ca; sajyaṃ kṛtaṃ tena tathā prasahya yathā ca bhāṣanti parasparaṃ te; channā dhruvaṃ te pracaranti pārthāḥ
english: "As the target was struck down and the bow forcefully strung by him, and as they speak among themselves — undoubtedly those Pārthas move about in disguise."

sanskrit: tataḥ sa rājā drupadaḥ prahṛṣṭaḥ; purohitaṃ preṣayāṃ tatra cakre vidyāma yuṣmān iti bhāṣamāṇo; mahātmanaḥ pāṇḍusutāḥ stha kaccit
english: Then King Drupada, filled with joy, dispatched his priest there, with the words: "We would know who you are — are you the great-souled sons of Pāṇḍu?"

sanskrit: gṛhītavākyo nṛpateḥ purodhā; gatvā praśaṃsām abhidhāya teṣām vākyaṃ yathāvan nṛpateḥ samagram; uvāca tān sa kramavit krameṇa
english: The king's priest, having received his instructions, went and greeted them with praise, then delivered the king's message completely and in proper order, he who knew the right procedure.

sanskrit: vijñātum icchaty avanīśvaro vaḥ; pāñcālarājo drupado varārhāḥ lakṣyasya veddhāram imaṃ hi dṛṣṭvā; harṣasya nāntaṃ paripaśyate saḥ
english: "The lord of the earth, King Drupada of Pāñcāla, desires to know who you are, O worthy ones; having seen this striker of the target, he finds no limit to his joy."

sanskrit: tad ācaḍḍhvaṃ jñātikulānupūrvīṃ; padaṃ śiraḥsu dviṣatāṃ kurudhvam prahlādayadhvaṃ hṛdayaṃ mamedaṃ; pāñcālarājasya sahānugasya
english: "Therefore declare your lineage and family in order; set your foot upon the heads of your enemies; and gladden my heart and that of King Drupada with his retinue."

sanskrit: pāṇḍur hi rājā drupadasya rājñaḥ; priyaḥ sakhā cātmasamo babhūva tasyaiṣa kāmo duhitā mameyaṃ; snuṣā yadi syād iti kauravasya
english: "For King Pāṇḍu was the beloved friend of King Drupada, equal to himself; and it was his desire that this daughter of mine might become a daughter-in-law of the Kaurava."

sanskrit: ayaṃ ca kāmo drupadasya rājño; hṛdi sthito nityam aninditāṅgāḥ yad arjuno vai pṛthudīrghabāhur; dharmeṇa vindeta sutāṃ mameti
english: "And this desire has ever dwelt in the heart of King Drupada, O you of blameless limbs — that Arjuna, with his broad and long arms, might win my daughter by righteous means."

sanskrit: tathoktavākyaṃ tu purohitaṃ taṃ; sthitaṃ vinītaṃ samudīkṣya rājā samīpasthaṃ bhīmam idaṃ śaśāsa; pradīyatāṃ pādyam arghyaṃ tathāsmai
english: The king, hearing the priest speak thus and seeing him standing there humbly, commanded Bhīma who stood nearby: "Let water for washing the feet and the gift of honor be given to him."

sanskrit: mānyaḥ purodhā drupadasya rājñas; tasmai prayojyābhyadhikaiva pūjā bhīmas tathā tat kṛtavān narendra; tāṃ caiva pūjāṃ pratisaṃgṛhītvā
english: "The priest of King Drupada is worthy of honor; for him an especially great worship must be offered." Bhīma did exactly so, O lord of men; and having received that honor,

sanskrit: sukhopaviṣṭaṃ tu purohitaṃ taṃ; yudhiṣṭhiro brāhmaṇam ity uvāca pāñcālarājena sutā nisṛṣṭā; svadharmadṛṣṭena yathānukāmam
english: when that priest was seated comfortably, Yudhiṣṭhira addressed him as a brahmin: "The daughter has been given away by King Drupada of Pāñcāla in accordance with his own dharma, as he pleased."

sanskrit: pradiṣṭaśulkā drupadena rājñā; sānena vīreṇa tathānuvṛttā na tatra varṇeṣu kṛtā vivakṣā; na jīvaśilpe na kule na gotre
english: "The bride-price was fixed by King Drupada; by this hero it was fulfilled accordingly; no distinction was made regarding varna, occupation, family lineage, or clan."

sanskrit: kṛtena sajyena hi kārmukeṇa; viddhena lakṣyeṇa ca saṃnisṛṣṭā seyaṃ tathānena mahātmaneha; kṛṣṇā jitā pārthivasaṃghamadhye
english: "By the stringing of the bow and the striking of the target was she awarded; and thus by this great-souled one was Kṛṣṇa here won in the midst of the assembly of kings."

sanskrit: naivaṃgate saumakir adya rājā; saṃtāpam arhaty asukhāya kartum kāmaś ca yo 'sau drupadasya rājñaḥ; sa cāpi saṃpatsyati pārthivasya
english: "Things being thus, the son of Somaka, the king, should not today grieve to his displeasure; and that desire which King Drupada harbored — that too shall be fulfilled for the lord of the earth."

sanskrit: aprāpyarūpāṃ hi narendrakanyām; imām ahaṃ brāhmaṇa sādhu manye na tad dhanur mandabalena śakyaṃ; maurvyā samāyojayituṃ tathā hi na cākṛtāstreṇa na hīnajena; lakṣyaṃ tathā pātayituṃ hi śakyam
english: "For I deem it right, O brahmin, that this princess is one hard to obtain; that bow could not be strung with its bowstring by one of feeble strength — nor could such a target be struck down by one untrained in weaponry or of low birth."

sanskrit: tasmān na tāpaṃ duhitur nimittaṃ; pāñcālarājo 'rhati kartum adya na cāpi tat pātanam anyatheha; kartuṃ viṣahyaṃ bhuvi mānavena
english: "Therefore King Pāñcāla does not deserve to grieve today on account of his daughter; nor indeed could that feat of striking the target otherwise have been accomplished by any mortal on earth."

sanskrit: evaṃ bruvaty eva yudhiṣṭhire tu; pāñcālarājasya samīpato 'nyaḥ tatrājagāmāśu naro dvitīyo; nivedayiṣyann iha siddham annam
english: Even as Yudhiṣṭhira was speaking thus, another man arrived quickly from the vicinity of the Pāñcāla king to announce that the meal was ready.

sanskrit: dūta uvāca janyārtham annaṃ drupadena rājñā; vivāhahetor upasaṃskṛtaṃ ca tad āpnuvadhvaṃ kṛtasarvakāryāḥ; kṛṣṇā ca tatraiva ciraṃ na kāryam
english: The messenger said: "Food has been prepared by King Drupada for the occasion of the wedding; come, receive it now that all arrangements are complete; and Kṛṣṇa should not delay there any longer."

sanskrit: ime rathāḥ kāñcanapadmacitrāḥ; sadaśvayuktā vasudhādhipārhāḥ etān samāruhya paraita sarve; pāñcālarājasya niveśanaṃ tat
english: "These chariots, adorned with golden lotuses and yoked with good horses, fit for lords of the earth — mount them all and proceed to the palace of King Pāñcāla."

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca tataḥ prayātāḥ kurupuṃgavās te; purohitaṃ taṃ prathamaṃ prayāpya āsthāya yānāni mahānti tāni; kuntī ca kṛṣṇā ca sahaiva yāte
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Then those bulls among the Kurus set out, sending the priest ahead first, mounting those great vehicles; and Kuntī and Kṛṣṇa went along together.

sanskrit: śrutvā tu vākyāni purohitasya; yāny uktavān bhārata dharmarājaḥ jijñāsayaivātha kurūttamānāṃ; dravyāṇy anekāny upasaṃjahāra
english: Hearing the words which Dharmarāja had spoken, O Bharata, and wishing to learn more about those foremost Kurus, Drupada gathered together many kinds of goods.

sanskrit: phalāni mālyāni susaṃskṛtāni; carmāṇi varmāṇi tathāsanāni gāś caiva rājann atha caiva rajjūr; dravyāṇi cānyāni kṛṣīnimittam
english: Fruits and garlands finely prepared, hides and armor and seats, cattle, O king, and also ropes and other implements for agriculture —

sanskrit: anyeṣu śilpeṣu ca yāny api syuḥ; sarvāṇi kḷptāny akhilena tatra krīḍānimittāni ca yāni tāni; sarvāṇi tatropajahāra rājā
english: and whatever there might be in the various crafts, all of it completely arranged and ready, and also those things intended for sport — all of this the king assembled there.

sanskrit: rathāśvavarmāṇi ca bhānumanti; khaḍgā mahānto 'śvarathāś ca citrāḥ dhanūṃṣi cāgryāṇi śarāś ca mukhyāḥ; śaktyṛṣṭayaḥ kāñcanabhūṣitāś ca
english: Gleaming chariots, horses and armor, great swords and splendid horse-drawn vehicles, foremost bows and principal arrows, lances and javelins adorned with gold —

sanskrit: prāsā bhuśuṇḍyaś ca paraśvadhāś ca; sāṃgrāmikaṃ caiva tathaiva sarvam śayyāsanāny uttamasaṃskṛtāni; tathaiva cāsan vividhāni tatra
english: javelins, bhuśuṇḍi weapons and battle-axes, and likewise all manner of war equipment; beds and seats of the finest quality — all these too were arranged variously there.

sanskrit: kuntī tu kṛṣṇāṃ parigṛhya sādhvīm; antaḥpuraṃ drupadasyāviveṣa striyaś ca tāṃ kauravarājapatnīṃ; pratyarcayāṃ cakrur adīnasattvāḥ
english: Kuntī, taking the virtuous Kṛṣṇa with her, entered the inner apartments of Drupada; and the women, of noble spirit, received and honored that wife of the Kaurava king.

sanskrit: tān siṃhavikrāntagatīn avekṣya; maharṣabhākṣān ajinottarīyān gūḍhottarāṃsān bhujagendrabhoga;pralambabāhūn puruṣapravīrān
english: Beholding those foremost of men — with the gait of lion's valor, with the eyes of great bulls, wearing antelope hides as upper garments, with shoulders hidden, with arms as long and thick as the bodies of great serpents —

sanskrit: rājā ca rājñaḥ sacivāś ca sarve; putrāś ca rājñaḥ suhṛdas tathaiva preṣyāś ca sarve nikhilena rājan; harṣaṃ samāpetur atīva tatra
english: the king and all the king's ministers, the king's sons and friends likewise, and all the servants without exception, O king, were filled with the greatest joy there.

sanskrit: te tatra vīrāḥ paramāsaneṣu; sapādapīṭheṣv aviśaṅkamānāḥ yathānupūrvyā viviśur narāgryās; tadā mahārheṣu na vismayantaḥ
english: Those heroes, those foremost of men, without any hesitation and without showing wonder, took their seats in order of seniority upon the excellent thrones with their footstools, as was their due.

sanskrit: uccāvacaṃ pārthivabhojanīyaṃ; pātrīṣu jāmbūnadarājatīṣu dāsāś ca dāsyaś ca sumṛṣṭaveṣāḥ; bhojāpakāś cāpy upajahrur annam
english: Male and female servants in fine attire, and cooks too, brought food fit for kings — varied and of high and low rank — served in vessels of gold and silver.

sanskrit: te tatra bhuktvā puruṣapravīrā; yathānukāmaṃ subhṛśaṃ pratītāḥ utkramya sarvāṇi vasūni tatra; sāṃgrāmikāny āviviśur nṛvīrāḥ
english: Those foremost of men ate there as they wished and were greatly satisfied; then, passing over all the goods arranged there, those heroic men chose the weapons of war.

sanskrit: tal lakṣayitvā drupadasya putro; rājā ca sarvaiḥ saha mantrimukhyaiḥ samarcayām āsur upetya hṛṣṭāḥ; kuntīsutān pārthivaputrapautrān
english: Noticing this, Drupada's son and the king, together with all his chief ministers, came forward joyfully and honored the sons of Kuntī as princes and heirs of kings.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca tata āhūya pāñcālyo rājaputraṃ yudhiṣṭhiram parigraheṇa brāhmeṇa parigṛhya mahādyutiḥ
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Then the Pāñcāla king, of great splendor, summoned prince Yudhiṣṭhira and drew him close with a brahminical embrace.

sanskrit: paryapṛcchad adīnātmā kuntīputraṃ suvarcasam kathaṃ jānīma bhavataḥ kṣatriyān brāhmaṇān uta
english: He of undepressed spirit questioned the radiant son of Kuntī: "How are we to know of you — are you Kṣatriyas, or Brahmins,

sanskrit: vaiśyān vā guṇasaṃpannān uta vā śūdrayonijān māyām āsthāya vā siddhāṃś carataḥ sarvatodiśam
english: "or Vaiśyas endowed with virtues, or those born of Śūdra stock, or perfected beings ranging in all directions, having taken up a form of illusion?"

sanskrit: kṛṣṇāhetor anuprāptān divaḥ saṃdarśanārthinaḥ bravītu no bhavān satyaṃ saṃdeho hy atra no mahān
english: "Come from the heavens to behold us, having arrived here for the sake of Kṛṣṇa — tell us the truth; our doubt in this matter is great."

sanskrit: api naḥ saṃśayasyānte manastuṣṭir ihāviśet api no bhāgadheyāni śubhāni syuḥ paraṃtapa
english: "If at the end of our uncertainty a satisfaction might enter the mind here, and if our good fortune might prove auspicious — O scorcher of enemies."

sanskrit: kāmayā brūhi satyaṃ tvaṃ satyaṃ rājasu śobhate iṣṭāpūrtena ca tathā vaktavyam anṛtaṃ na tu
english: "Tell the truth willingly; truth is becoming in kings; likewise by religious sacrifice and meritorious deeds — and falsehood must not be spoken."

sanskrit: śrutvā hy amarasaṃkāśa tava vākyam ariṃdama dhruvaṃ vivāhakaraṇam āsthāsyāmi vidhānataḥ
english: "For having heard your words, O one equal to the immortals, O subduer of foes, I shall certainly proceed to the conducting of the marriage according to the prescribed rites."

sanskrit: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca mā rājan vimanā bhūs tvaṃ pāñcālya prītir astu te īpsitas te dhruvaḥ kāmaḥ saṃvṛtto 'yam asaṃśayam
english: Yudhiṣṭhira said: "Do not be downcast, O king of Pāñcāla; let there be joy for you — your desired wish is certainly fulfilled, without doubt."

sanskrit: vayaṃ hi kṣatriyā rājan pāṇḍoḥ putrā mahātmanaḥ jyeṣṭhaṃ māṃ viddhi kaunteyaṃ bhīmasenārjunāv imau yābhyāṃ tava sutā rājan nirjitā rājasaṃsadi
english: "We are indeed Kṣatriyas, O king, sons of the great-souled Pāṇḍu; know me as the eldest, Kunteyaka; these are Bhīmasena and Arjuna, by whom, O king, your daughter was won in the royal assembly."

sanskrit: yamau tu tatra rājendra yatra kṛṣṇā pratiṣṭhitā vyetu te mānasaṃ duḥkhaṃ kṣatriyāḥ smo nararṣabha padminīva suteyaṃ te hradād anyaṃ hradaṃ gatā
english: "And the twins are there where Kṛṣṇa has taken her place; let the grief depart from your mind — we are Kṣatriyas, O bull among men; your daughter has gone from one lake to another, like a lotus."

sanskrit: iti tathyaṃ mahārāja sarvam etad bravīmi te bhavān hi gurur asmākaṃ paramaṃ ca parāyaṇam
english: "Thus truthfully, O great king, I tell you all of this; you are indeed our highest elder and supreme refuge."

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca tataḥ sa drupado rājā harṣavyākulalocanaḥ prativaktuṃ tadā yuktaṃ nāśakat taṃ yudhiṣṭhiram
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Then King Drupada, his eyes stirred with joy, was unable at that moment to make a fitting reply to Yudhiṣṭhira.

sanskrit: yatnena tu sa taṃ harṣaṃ saṃnigṛhya paraṃtapaḥ anurūpaṃ tato rājā pratyuvāca yudhiṣṭhiram
english: But with effort suppressing that joy, the scorcher of foes, the king, then replied fittingly to Yudhiṣṭhira.

sanskrit: papraccha cainaṃ dharmātmā yathā te pradrutāḥ purā sa tasmai sarvam ācakhyāv ānupūrvyeṇa pāṇḍavaḥ
english: The righteous-souled king asked him how they had fled before; and the Pāṇḍava told him everything in full sequence.

sanskrit: tac chrutvā drupado rājā kuntīputrasya bhāṣitam vigarhayām āsa tadā dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ janeśvaram
english: Hearing the words of the son of Kuntī, King Drupada then censured Dhṛtarāṣṭra, lord of the people.

sanskrit: āśvāsayām āsa ca taṃ kuntīputraṃ yudhiṣṭhiram pratijajñe ca rājyāya drupado vadatāṃ varaḥ
english: And Drupada, foremost of speakers, reassured the son of Kuntī, Yudhiṣṭhira, and pledged his support for their restoration to the kingdom.

sanskrit: tataḥ kuntī ca kṛṣṇā ca bhīmasenārjunāv api yamau ca rājñā saṃdiṣṭau viviśur bhavanaṃ mahat
english: Then Kuntī and Kṛṣṇa, Bhīmasena and Arjuna, and the twins, as directed by the king, entered the great palace.

sanskrit: tatra te nyavasan rājan yajñasenena pūjitāḥ pratyāśvastāṃs tato rājā saha putrair uvāca tān
english: There they resided, O king, honored by Yajñasena; and then the king, together with his sons, spoke to them when they were at ease.

sanskrit: gṛhṇātu vidhivat pāṇim adyaiva kurunandanaḥ puṇye 'hani mahābāhur arjunaḥ kurutāṃ kṣaṇam
english: "Let the joy of the Kurus take her hand today itself according to the prescribed rite; on an auspicious day let the mighty-armed Arjuna choose the moment."

sanskrit: tatas tam abravīd rājā dharmaputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ mamāpi dārasaṃbandhaḥ kāryas tāvad viśāṃ pate
english: Then king Yudhiṣṭhira, son of Dharma, said to him: "A marriage alliance must first be made for me as well, O lord of the people."

sanskrit: drupada uvāca bhavān vā vidhivat pāṇiṃ gṛhṇātu duhitur mama yasya vā manyase vīra tasya kṛṣṇām upādiśa
english: Drupada said: "Either you yourself take my daughter's hand according to the prescribed rite, or, O hero, assign Kṛṣṇa to whomever you think fit."

sanskrit: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca sarveṣāṃ draupadī rājan mahiṣī no bhaviṣyati evaṃ hi vyāhṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ mama mātrā viśāṃ pate
english: Yudhiṣṭhira said: "Draupadī shall be the queen of all of us, O king; for thus it was spoken before by my mother, O lord of the people."

sanskrit: ahaṃ cāpy aniviṣṭo vai bhīmasenaś ca pāṇḍavaḥ pārthena vijitā caiṣā ratnabhūtā ca te sutā
english: "And I have not yet married, nor has Bhīmasena the Pāṇḍava; she was won by Pārtha, and your daughter is a jewel among women."

sanskrit: eṣa naḥ samayo rājan ratnasya sahabhojanam na ca taṃ hātum icchāmaḥ samayaṃ rājasattama
english: "This is our compact, O king — to share a jewel in common; and we do not wish to abandon that compact, O best of kings."

sanskrit: sarveṣāṃ dharmataḥ kṛṣṇā mahiṣī no bhaviṣyati ānupūrvyeṇa sarveṣāṃ gṛhṇātu jvalane karam
english: "By dharma, Kṛṣṇa shall be the queen of all of us; in order of seniority let each of us take her hand by the sacred fire."

sanskrit: drupada uvāca ekasya bahvyo vihitā mahiṣyaḥ kurunandana naikasyā bahavaḥ puṃso vidhīyante kadā cana
english: Drupada said: "Many queens are ordained for one man, O joy of the Kurus; but never is one woman ordained for many men at any time."
